JUBILEE LINE: No service between Wembley Park and Willesden Green and SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line.

METROPOLITAN LINE: No service between Harrow-on-the-Hill and Aldgate and SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line.

Use London Buses route 382 between Finchley Central and Mill Hill East and Night Bus N20 between Archway and High Barnet during Night Tube hours.
